purpose: Teach: 乗り出し/幾何/高揚/恣意/乖離/排他/占拠/屈辱

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代国家が改革に乗り出した時期を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the period when the modern state undertook reform in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging opening. Genuinely interested — checking in on his work. Steady pace, conversational. A teacher recognizing a student's effort.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、幾何学の発展史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the history of geometric development in my paper.
lines.style: Careful, slightly defensive correction. Not argumentative, but precise. Quietly pushing back on the assumption. Even pace, measured.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、革命期の民衆の高揚を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you explored the popular enthusiasm during the revolutionary period in your work, didn't you.
lines.style: Reflective, almost thinking aloud. Gentle rephrasing, still probing. Not testing — genuinely trying to understand what he actually wrote. Slight pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、行政の恣意的判断を批判した文献を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined literature that criticized arbitrary government judgment in my paper.
lines.style: Another careful correction, slightly more direct this time. Not frustrated, but standing his ground. Steady breath. Doesn't rush the explanation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政策と現実の乖離を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed the gap between policy and reality in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: More direct now, less question-form. Teacher engaging more actively with the content. Attentive, following a thread. Slight lean-in energy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、排他的なイデオロギーの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on research into exclusionary ideologies in my paper.
lines.style: Firmer now. He knows where this is going. Not resistant, but committed to accuracy. Holds his line. Even, clear delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、市庁占拠事件の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you traced the history of the city hall occupation incident in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. The final observation before the real point. Teacher's voice carries weight now — respectful, but there's something she wants him to acknowledge.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の屈辱の証言を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined testimonies of humiliation during wartime in my paper.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. He's said it now. No hesitation, no softening. The answer has been there the whole time. Slight exhale at the end — relief or resignation.
